item.title: Red Cross of Southern Nevada volunteers deploy to Hawaii to aid flood victims
item.description: LAS VEGAS (KLAS) -- Several American Red Cross of Southern Nevada volunteers headed to Honolulu, Hawaii, to support communities devastated after historic flooding hit the island. item.title: Historic heat wave continues to break records in Las Vegas
item.description: The historic heat wave continues with that strong heat dome over the southwest, bringing temps 20-30 degrees above normal.

item.title: Family sues after deadly AutoZone shooting in Las Vegas; suspect released from prison weeks earlier
item.description: A family is taking legal action following a deadly shooting inside a Las Vegas auto parts store, alleging the business failed to provide adequate security despite known safety risks.

item.title: Las Vegas man faces DUI-related charges after 3-vehicle crash: police
item.description: LAS VEGAS (KLAS) -- A Las Vegas man faces DUI-related charges after a three-vehicle crash in the northwest valley on Monday, according to police. item.title: Henderson, police unions reach deal, again
item.description: The battle between Henderson City Hall and their police unions was supposed to be over, but a closed-door agreement reveals peace was struck once some lawyers were outside the room.

item.title: Vehicle hits pole in southeast Las Vegas valley causing power outage; driver faces charges
item.description: A vehicle hit a pole in the southeast Las Vegas valley Tuesday morning, causing a small power outage, police said. The driver of that vehicle showed signs of impairment and is facing charges.

item.title: Las Vegas asst. principal allegedly had sexual relationship with 14-year-old
item.description: The assistant principal of a local charter school allegedly started a relationship with a 14-year-old girl and threatened her so she wouldn't say anything, prosecutors said in court Tuesday morning.

item.title: 2 hikers pulled off ledge in rescue at Valley of Fire northeast of Las Vegas
item.description: Two hikers were rescued at Valley of Fire State Park on Monday night after they couldn't climb down from a ledge about 60 feet up, according to Metro Search and Rescue.

item.title: Mystic Fair returns with manifestation, a séance, tarot, palm readings, aura photography
item.description: An event that attracted about 2,000 people last year returns on Saturday, March 28, as the Mystic Fair comes to the Windmill Library.

item.title: 11-year-old girl sexually abused 6-year-old at elite Las Vegas private school camp, family says in lawsuit
item.description: A family has filed a lawsuit against a Las Vegas private school alleging their daughter was sexually abused by another child in a restroom at camp.

item.title: Feds bust multiple marijuana grow houses across Las Vegas; 4 in custody
item.description: Four people face federal charges for allegedly running marijuana grow houses across the Las Vegas valley involving thousands of marijuana plants, the 8 News Now Investigators have learned.

item.title: Motorcyclist in critical condition after Las Vegas crash
item.description: A motorcyclist was transported to the hospital with life-threatening injuries after a crash with a vehicle near St. Rose Parkway and Jeffreys Street in Las Vegas on Tuesday afternoon.

item.title: Nevada state employees face higher health rates in July
item.description: Current and former state employees will see higher health insurance rates beginning in July after the Public Employees’ Benefits Board approved the increase in a March 19 meeting.

item.title: North Las Vegas leading mayoral candidate faces legal challenge on term limits
item.description: LAS VEGAS (KLAS) -- North Las Vegas Councilman Scott Black has served nine years on the city council and is attempting to serve a new term as mayor. item.title: NBA board approves expansion into Las Vegas, bidding process to start
item.description: League owners voted to approve NBA expansion teams in both Las Vegas and Seattle on Wednesday, ESPN reported. This vote now allows for the league to explore bids and applicants for the new teams.
